raw_segments.text: Oh no, there are people of deep feeling who have been somehow crushed.
Bafoonery in them is a form of resentful irony against those to whom they daren't speak
the truth, from having been for years humiliated and intimidated by them.
Believe me, Krasetkin, that sort of buffoonery is sometimes tragic in the extreme.
His whole life now is centered in Elisha, and if Elisha dies, he will either go mad
I feel almost certain of that when I look at him now.
